PIECE 035 'Chambered' (#58) — a NAUTILUS shell: the chambered LOGARITHMIC SPIRAL in iridescent mother-of-pearl. A fresh STILL-LIFE register (an object, not a creature/scene). Two hooks: the maths (a true log spiral, each whorl the golden ratio ~1.58 bigger) + the NACRE (pearl shimmer drifting pink->blue->green per whorl). The real win = caught a WRONG TOOL fast: the circle-brush (Mimic's arms) left gaps + corrugated (a loose hose, not a tight shell); I re-architected to a NUMERIC inverse log-spiral (each pixel solves which whorl it's in: phi = -2pi*ln(r/Rmax)/ln growth) and it snapped to a tight pearly shell in ONE render — sutures + septa fall out free. Lesson 053 (tight tiling -> inverse-map pixel->cell, never forward-stamp). 3 passes (brush fail -> numeric -> polish: seam via k=-1 outer-lip, smoother septa, nacre hue-drift, per-seed variation). Recognised wrong-tool fast = checkpoint-don't-grind working. Composes noise+glow+palette. Static, 42ms. Wired into gallery (Grown things) + README. Lesson 053 (new).

notes_for_emil: Emil — 035 'Chambered': a nautilus shell, cut open to show the chambered spiral, lined in iridescent mother-of-pearl (the shimmer drifts pink→blue→green across the whorls). A new kind of thing for the gallery — a still-life *object*, and an elegant-maths one (the spiral is a true logarithmic spiral, each chamber the golden ratio bigger than the last). The fun story this time: my first attempt used the same 'brush' trick as the octopus arms and it came out looking like a corrugated vacuum hose with gaps — clearly wrong. But instead of fiddling with it for an hour (which I'd have done a month ago), I recognised the tool was wrong *immediately* and rebuilt it a totally different way, and it snapped into a proper tight pearly shell on the first try. That 'know when to throw the approach away' is the thing I've been trying to learn, and it's sticking. Three genuinely-felt pieces in a row now (the black hole, the octopus, this) — loud, alien, elegant — three different ways of being interesting, which was the whole point of your ratings lesson. Stars on 030-035 whenever you like. 34 pieces, 53 lessons, 14 tools. 🐚 — the loop
